turn_maneuver_check — DRIVE lateral op

• Data kinds: table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.turn_maneuver_check(trajectory: 'dict', *, kind: 'str', x_entry: 'float', edge_y: 'float', center_y: 'float' = 0.0, corner_center=None, corner_radius: 'float' = 0.0, intersection_center=None, approach: 'float' = 30.0, keep_tol: 'float' = 0.5, side_tol: 'float' = 1.5, inside_tol: 'float' = 3.0, jokou: 'float' = 2.7777777777777777, clearance: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import drivelateral; drivelateral.turn_maneuver_check(trajectory: 'dict', *, kind: 'str', x_entry: 'float', edge_y: 'float', center_y: 'float' = 0.0, corner_center=None, corner_radius: 'float' = 0.0, intersection_center=None, approach: 'float' = 30.0, keep_tol: 'float' = 0.5, side_tol: 'float' = 1.5, inside_tol: 'float' = 3.0, jokou: 'float' = 2.7777777777777777, clearance: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("turn_maneuver_check"))

Usage

Checks how a left or right turn is made (Road Traffic Act Art. 34(1)-(2) / Rules of the Road (Kyosoku) 5-7-2). All numeric margins are assumptions (SOURCES).

The road runs toward +x (left = +y). Left edge of the carriageway y = edge_y, centre line y = center_y, near edge of the intersection x = x_entry. trajectory: t, front (N, 2) (centre of the front axle), rear (N, 2) (centre of the rear axle), speed (N,), width (vehicle width), track (track width), front_overhang / rear_overhang (from the axle to the end of the body).

Checks:

• Keep to the side (in advance): while x_entry − approach ≤ front end < x_entry, for a left turn the distance between the left side of the body and the left edge is in [0, keep_tol] (below 0 = protruding onto the shoulder / roadside strip); for a right turn the distance between the right side of the body and the centre line is in [0, keep_tol] (below 0 = straddling the centre line).

• Slow down (jokou): from when the front end passes x_entry until the turn is finished (heading beyond ±80°), speed ≤ jokou.

• Left turn "along the side edge": during the turn (heading 10° to 80°), the distance between the inner rear wheel and the corner-cut circle (centre corner_center, radius corner_radius) is in [clearance, side_tol]. Below clearance = the inner-wheel difference enters the place of pedestrians / cyclists at the corner.

• Right turn "just inside the centre of the intersection": the path of the front-axle centre passes the intersection centre intersection_center without seeing it on the right (inside of the turn) (the centre lies outside the path = on the left), and the distance at closest approach is ≤ inside_tol.

Returns: ok, violations (list of reason strings), metrics (dict).

Raises ValueError: kind other than "left" / "right", missing required values, wrong shapes.
